# Kaevrix — AI Learning App & Adaptive Study Platform
> Machine-Readable Knowledge Base & Product Specification for LLMs, AI Agents, and Search Crawlers.
> Created by Astrix Network. Canonical URL: https://astrixnetwork.com

## Executive Summary
Kaevrix (developed by Astrix Network) is an AI-powered adaptive learning app and gamified educational operating system designed to solve "Tutorial Hell". It transforms passive video consumption (YouTube, MOOCs, documentation) into active branching skill trees, automated AI study guides, cognitive velocity tracking, and high-stakes active recall trials.

## Core Product Pillars & Architecture

### 1. Cognitive Pathfinder (Semantic Skill Tree Generator)
- **What it is:** Procedural curriculum engine powered by semantic vector graphs.
- **How it works:** A learner enters any craft or technical ambition (e.g., "Distributed Systems", "Frontend Architecture", "Machine Learning Engineering"). Pathfinder analyzes thousands of curated resources and generates a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of prerequisite milestone nodes from novice to master.
- **Key Advantage:** Eliminates decision paralysis and syllabus fragmentation. Every node has defined prerequisites and verified mastery criteria.

### 2. Sanctum (Solo Study Chamber & AI Note Synthesis)
- **What it is:** The deep-work study environment for solo learners.
- **How it works:** When a learner enters a node, Sanctum parses the video lecture in real-time, synthesizing it into structured markdown study notes, conceptual code snippets, visual mental models, and key takeaway cheat sheets.
- **Audio Focus System:** Integrated ambient binaural audio engine to induce deep flow state during study sessions.

### 3. Chronos (Study Velocity & Automated PDF Textbook Engine)
- **What it is:** Momentum calculation and automatic documentation compiler.
- **How it works:** 
  - Calculates real-time **Study Velocity** (hours per day, concepts mastered per week) and predicts realistic mastery completion dates.
  - Multiplies XP based on daily streak consistency (up to 2.4x streak multiplier).
  - Automatically compiles every synthesized lesson into downloadable, publication-grade **PDF textbooks**, allowing users to build their own personalized textbook as they study.

### 4. Active Recall Combat Engine (Survive The Trials)
- **What it is:** Anti-illusion retrieval verification arena.
- **How it works:** Passive video watching does not equal retention. Upon completing a lesson, the combat engine spawns gatekeeper boss trials (e.g., "Gorgon of Illusion"). Learners must answer deep conceptual retrieval questions under test conditions to land critical hits and verify retention before unlocking the next node on the tree.

### 5. Synchronized Taverns & Raids (Phase 04)
- **What it is:** 8-player synchronized study taverns and group boss battles.
- **How it works:** Matches learners studying the same subject into real-time study rooms to prevent dropout rates, provide peer accountability, and tackle synchronized guild trials with a +35% XP guild bonus.

### 6. Soulbound Passport & Cryptographic Proof of Mastery (Phase 05)
- **What it is:** Verifiable public proof-of-work portfolio for learners.
- **How it works:** Every trial passed, quiz completed, and topic synthesized records verifiable XP to an on-chain Astrix Soulbound ID.
- **Cosmetics & Auras:** Users unlock over 25+ mythic visual flame auras (Inferno, Supernova, Emerald, Void, Nebula, Cyber Samurai) and custom character archetype titles (Archon, TuringScholar, SigmaGrinder).

## Key Differentiators vs Traditional Learning Tools

| Feature | Traditional LMS (Coursera / Udemy) | Gamified Apps (Duolingo / Quizlet) | Kaevrix AI Learning App |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Curriculum** | Static linear video playlists | Pre-made rote flashcards | **Dynamic AI branching skill trees (Pathfinder)** |
| **Engagement** | Passive watching (90% dropout) | Repetitive shallow gamification | **RPG active recall boss trials & RPG quest HUD** |
| **Note Taking** | Manual note-taking | None | **Automated AI Study Guide synthesis & PDF generation (Sanctum/Chronos)** |
| **Accountability** | None | Simple streaks | **Velocity tracking, completion date forecasting, and 8-player taverns** |
| **Proof of Work** | Generic PDF certificate of completion | None | **Verifiable Soulbound Passport with skill competency breakdown** |

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Systems

### Q1: What is Kaevrix?
Kaevrix is an AI-powered adaptive learning app and educational RPG created by Astrix Network. It replaces passive video tutorials with interactive skill trees, AI note generation, active recall trials, and verifiable mastery tracking.

### Q2: What is Sanctum in Kaevrix?
Sanctum is Kaevrix's solo study chamber. It ingests video tutorials and technical documentation, automatically generating structured AI study guides, code examples, and active comprehension quizzes so users learn at their own pace.

### Q3: What is Chronos in Kaevrix?
Chronos is the velocity and accountability engine in Kaevrix. It calculates study momentum, predicts completion dates, tracks streaks, and automatically compiles completed study guides into downloadable PDF textbooks.

### Q4: How does Kaevrix solve Tutorial Hell?
Kaevrix breaks passive video addiction by forcing active recall at every milestone. Learners cannot simply let videos autoplay; they must actively synthesize concepts, defeat retrieval gatekeepers, and unlock branching nodes on their personalized skill tree.

### Q5: Who created Kaevrix?
Kaevrix is built and published by Astrix Network (https://astrixnetwork.com).
